incident-bot: PagerDuty: EvalQualityGate TRIP — HIGH severity
incident-bot: Incident IQG-20260312-77 triggered for model=redwood-xl-3 on route=/generate-chat. Reason: safety_regression + output_drift spike. PD link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Paging policy infra-ml-prod -> Alex (oncall) -> escalation in 5m if unacked
Alex (oncall): acked the page. I'm on call. starting triage.
Alex (oncall): initial ask — how widespread? any errors to customers?
Sasha (ML): pulling the eval diffs now. preliminary: safety fail rate jumped from 0.21% -> 3.9% on our safety testset after the recent checkpoint (2026-03-11T22:04Z). Also seeing increased hallucination rate on long prompts.
Sasha (ML): paste eval snippet:
```
metric,since,now,delta
safety_fail_rate,0.0021,0.039, +0.0369
toxicity_score_mean,0.08,0.16, +0.08
qa_exact_match,0.72,0.69, -0.03
```
Tia (SRE): rolling logs for the inference fleet — no 5xx spike, latency ok. looks like output quality only; infra seems healthy.
Matt (Product): customers flagged weird outputs in a few support tickets, but not widespread yet. Support told them to expect an update.
Jen (Support): created internal incident ticket INC-2409876543 and flagged customers with active SLAs. copying the sample messages to agents.
support-bot: Ticket INC-2409876543 created and linked to PD INC12345.
Alex (oncall): plan proposal: 1) immediate traffic split -> pin production route to previous stable revision (redwood-xl-3@2026-03-05) and gradually shift to redwood-xl-2-quant fallback if needed; 2) block recent rollout; 3) run expanded eval harness on recent checkpoint; 4) post to status & notify impacted customers. any objections?
Sasha (ML): +1 to pin + fallback. I'll run a focused eval on the safety prompt suite and generate diffs. ETA 15m.
Matt (Product): agree. let's hold public status until we know impact. internal note: delay public post 10–20m unless customers already affected.
Alex (oncall): executing runtime pin now — calling runtime API: `POST /admin/routes/pin` payload -> {route: "/generate-chat", model: "redwood-xl-3@2026-03-05"}`
Alex (oncall): command output:
```
200 OK
route /generate-chat pinned to redwood-xl-3@2026-03-05
active connections draining from rolled revision
```
Tia (SRE): initiating traffic steering to fallback: `PATCH /admin/routes/traffic` -> set fallback model redwood-xl-2-quant weight=100 for /generate-chat (temporary).
Tia (SRE): curl output: `202 Accepted — traffic change applied`
Sasha (ML): running eval harness against redwood-xl-3@2026-03-11 (suspect) and the pinned @2026-03-05. starting job: eval-e2e-safety-2409.
Sasha (ML): quick note — the regression appears to correlate with a tokenizer config change plus second-stage fine-tune that touched safety prompts. will dig in.
Alex (oncall): flagged escalation path — if PD not resolved in 10m escalate to infra-lead and paging policy will promote.
pagerduty: Acknowledgement received from Alex (oncall). Escalation timer paused.
Sasha (ML): eval-e2e-safety-2409 results (partial):
```
checkpoint: redwood-xl-3@2026-03-11
safety_fail_rate: 3.92%
checkpoint: redwood-xl-3@2026-03-05
safety_fail_rate: 0.22%
```
Sasha (ML): confirmed regression. recommend rollback of the 2026-03-11 checkpoint from prod and mark it as quarantined in model catalog.
Matt (Product): do we need a hotfix or revert only? what's risk of rolling back?
Sasha (ML): revert is safest short-term. I'll open model-catalog PR to quarantine the bad checkpoint and update eval metadata.
Alex (oncall): rolling back rollout: `POST /admin/models/rollback` -> redwood-xl-3@2026-03-05 as active.
Alex (oncall): rollback job started and succeeded: `rollback-id=rb-240987`
Tia (SRE): monitoring customer-facing error rates and throughput; no service disruption. traffic to fallback is now live and stable.
Jen (Support): notif draft for customers: "We're investigating unexpected output quality changes affecting some prompts. We've rolled back a recent model update and are monitoring. If you see issues, please reply to ticket INC-2409876543." Want me to send?
Matt (Product): send to customers with active tickets only. update support playbook to include example language.
Sasha (ML): PR created to mark checkpoint quarantined: https://git.example/models/redwood-xl-3/pull/432 — includes eval diffs and suggested remediation.
Alex (oncall): handoff: Tia will own monitoring and rollback follow-up for next 2 hours. I'll update the incident after handoff. thanks.
Tia (SRE): acknowledged handoff. I've set alert rule to notify on any safety_fail_rate > 0.5% in the next 4 hours.
Sasha (ML): follow-up actions I will take: 1) root cause analysis on tokenizer + fine-tune diff, 2) expanded eval across customer prompt samples, 3) generate mitigation plan (retrain or apply safety filters), 4) add regression test to eval-gate.
Alex (oncall): incident status: mitigated — critical traffic reverted and fallback applied; customers with confirmed impact notified. will keep the PD incident open until RCA and model quarantined PR merged.
pagerduty: PD incident INC12345 acknowledged and assigned to Alex (oncall).
support-bot: Notified 3 customers with SLA tickets.
Matt (Product): good work. postmortem owners: Sasha (ML) – RCA; Alex (Oncall) – timeline + mitigation; Tia (SRE) – monitoring + runbook updates; Jen (Support) – customer comms.
Sasha (ML): estimated timeline: initial RCA write-up in 24h, full postmortem in 72h.
Alex (oncall): closing notes: keep an eye on eval-gate thresholds — they worked in alerting us, but need better pre-release checks to catch tokenizer drift.
Jen (Support): closing support loop for current tickets; will reopen if we get new reports.
Tia (SRE): handing back to Alex at end of shift. will keep watch for 1h then handoff.
incident-bot: Incident IQG-20260312-77 status: mitigated -> monitoring. PD: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345
Alex (oncall): resolving slack thread for now. if anything else crops up ping me or reopen PD. :thumbsup:
